findings.claim: After paper fill, observer/postfill/research/dynamics calls occur before open_trades authoritative record; only SupervisorySnapshotError is contained.
findings.impact: Unexpected observer or research exception can leave real paper broker position with no orchestrator open/protection record; comment Bookkeeping below always runs is stronger than implementation.
findings.action: First record actual filled quantity/price/identity and protective lifecycle durably; run non-authority observers only afterward with explicit fault containment. Require focused fault injection, not performed in this static audit.

findings.claim: Default Step5 candidate worker passes neither combined_cycle_runtime nor paper_journal.
findings.impact: New optional handoff/durability classes are not part of sealed Block1 worker execution. Default remains intraday/end-run flatten; capability existence is not integrated complete-system proof.
findings.action: Define separate explicit opted-in entrypoint and acceptance contract; preserve unchanged sealed reference worker.

findings.claim: External _system_state substitutes market age0, brokerconnectedTrue, offline0 and breakerFalse.
findings.impact: Broker/stale-feed gates see synthetic healthy replay inputs; standalone live reconciliation adapter does not fill these fields automatically.
findings.action: Label paper inputs explicitly; require measured broker/feed/interlock handoff for any live-runtime path.

findings.claim: Close-feedback receipts are processlocal; PENDING is installed before dispatch update then local governor update, and any failure blocks all retries.
findings.impact: Duplicate feedback prevented within process, but crash durability absent and partial dispatch/governor update is not atomic all-path exactly-once completion.
findings.action: Use durable close receipt/outbox with per-consumer acknowledgment and restart recovery; distinguish duplicate prevention from guaranteed delivery.

findings.claim: _execute_exit calls controller outcome telemetry before realized-R feedback and optional durable lifecycle close before open_trade deletion.
findings.impact: Telemetry failure can suppress feedback despite ledger close; optional persistence failure can interrupt deletion after broker flatten. Existing reordered bookkeeping improves normal research-failure consistency but is not complete crash-atomic broker/runtime close.
findings.action: Put authoritative close receipts/position removal before observer calls, transactionally journal consumer outcomes; use failclosed recovery when persistence fails.

findings.claim: Force-close _maybe_exit clock compares raw Timestamp.strftime while _in_trading_window normalizes exchange-local time.
findings.impact: Potential inconsistent clock semantics for tz-aware UTC input. This static observation does not establish affected prior trade timestamps.
findings.action: Normalize every lifecycle clock to the same exchange-local helper and verify UTC/IST equivalence in a focused approved fixture.

findings.claim: Stock boundary sentinel is excluded from trading clock but generic end-of-run reconciliation reads last data row.
findings.impact: Normally session exits leave no positions; if any remain, exit could use nextsession sentinel price rather than last target-session close.
findings.action: Assert no remaining intraday positions at block boundary or pass explicit target-end index to reconciler; never infer quarantine proof from clock alone.

findings.claim: Candidate identity guard allows selected tracked runner/protocol drift and uses git diff name-only; it does not audit all loaded module bytes/untracked code.
findings.impact: Tracked ancestry guard useful but not comprehensive loaded-code attestation. New integration branch is intentionally outside sealedparent contract.
findings.action: Record loaded module hashes in explicit experimental entrypoint; preserve strictparent rule for sealed candidate evaluator.

findings.claim: Kite product conversion correlation_id is echoed but not persisted or queried before conversion write.
findings.impact: Adapter verifies before/after quantities and avoids automatic write retry, but repeated caller invocation can convert again where sufficient source remains. Durable caller receipts remain necessary.
findings.action: Keep conversion behind durable request-state/idempotency manager and serialize reconciliation; never treat adapter return correlation as durable exactlyonce.

findings.claim: Standalone live broker reconciliation service is absent from frozen orchestrator imports/calls and default Step5 worker.
findings.impact: Read-only broker truth/protection capability exists but does not make historical engine a live reconciled operating system.
findings.action: Make explicit runtime admission consumer for receipt.new_risk_allowed and durable ownership records before enabling new risk; no live calls performed here.

findings.claim: simulate_trade_cycle returns submitted=True for nonSafeBrokerAdapter without invoking adapter submission.
findings.impact: This validation helper receipt is not proof of actual broker order.
findings.action: Label as contract simulation only; do not use as executed trade evidence.

findings.claim: ContractValidator.validate_order_payload accepts positive float/bool quantities, unlike ExecutionGate positiveinteger contract.
findings.impact: Validator disagreement can pass a payload that actual submit rejects; broad full_cycle result is not stronger than execution gate.
findings.action: Use shared strict order contract in an approved repair; record validationlayer currently differing.

findings.claim: Alternate Nautilus strategy is long-only local Bollinger reversal, its gridPID uses local -z_score, and dynamicstop ignores u_effort.
findings.impact: Alternate PID computation is partly advisory/non-actuating; does not represent NIFTY grid or sealed R5 engine migration.
